notes: Zones from the agency's GTFS-Flex feed (https://data.trilliumtransit.com/gtfs/sevt-vt-us/sevt-vt-us--flex-v2.zip, feed version 09-Nov-2026, calendar to 2027-06-01), used exactly as published: 'MicroMOO! Windsor' (area_1126) and 'Springfield MicroMoo' (area_1393), the only two MicroMOO services on moover.com. The feed's other zones are left out: MOOver! Dial-A-Ride (seniors and people with disabilities) and MOOver! ADA Paratransit. moover.com: 'Free transportation to all riders is available within the town limits of Windsor and Springfield Monday-Friday 6:00 am-6:00 pm by reservation.' Hours and booking from the Windsor and Springfield MicroMOO pages; the feed's windows match (6 a.m. to 6 p.m. weekdays). Southeast Vermont Transit runs MOOver; its fixed routes are not an Atlas agency, so this is an on-demand-only agency.
